description: Set target temperatures (nozzle, bed and/or chamber) on one or more printers - works while idle and mid-print. Values above the printer model maximum are clamped; 0 turns a heater off.

bed.description: Target heated bed temperature in degrees Celsius. 0 turns the bed heater off. Values above the printer model maximum are clamped. At least one of tool, bed or chamber is required.

chamber.description: Target chamber temperature in degrees Celsius. 0 turns the chamber heater off. Skipped for printers without an actively heated chamber. At least one of tool, bed or chamber is required.

tool.description: Target nozzle temperature in degrees Celsius. 0 turns the hotend off. Values above the printer model maximum are clamped. At least one of tool, bed or chamber is required.

tool_index.description: Zero-based tool index for multi-tool printers. Requires tool to be set. Defaults to 0.

name: set_printer_temperatures
